meta.title: Fair housing complaints by county and basis: Fair Housing Act cases filed with HUD, 2006 to June 2020
meta.attribution: Source: Probative, Fair housing complaints by county and basis: Fair Housing Act cases filed with HUD, 2006 to June 2020, version 1.0.0, https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23792758, licensed CC BY 4.0.
meta.citation: Probative. (2026). Fair housing complaints by county and basis: Fair Housing Act cases filed with HUD, 2006 to June 2020 (Version 1.0.0) [Data set]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23792758
meta.disclaimer: Not legal advice. These are counts of complaints filed with HUD; a filed case is an allegation, not a finding that discrimination occurred, and it is not a count of all housing discrimination (most is never reported). State and local fair housing agencies handle many complaints that never reach HUD. Rights and deadlines are for your own counsel.
meta.notice: Probative is a marketing firm, not a law firm; not legal advice.
